title: Shiraishi An — When The Floodgates Open〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
See you tomorrow... No, wait. We're not having practice tomorrow, are we?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You all fought pretty hard against Taiga, right? You need to give your throats a chance to recover.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We need to get back on our feet!)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Are you sure you don't want tea instead?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, I feel like coffee today.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sorry for calling you so suddenly. I know you're busy.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line:
Your eyes are bloodshot...
And, did you lose your voice?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, what's up? You hardly ever come here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which means... Mom, you also knew?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Yes... I'm sorry about keeping quiet this whole time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's okay...
Dad explained why no one told me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And what Aunt Nagi was thinking.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Because I believe in what I said.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: If anyone's going to succeed us, I'm absolutely positive that An will be one of those people.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Then, did you hear about this...?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Nagi always said she wanted to be the cool big sister you could always count on and look up to.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Taiga kept laughing at her that you were more like her daughter because she was so much older than you.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But being my daughter would mean I'd have to actually be responsible for her, wouldn't it? I don't think that kind of relationship suits us.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I'm going to be more like her friend or buddy...
Ooh, or we can be a pair of sworn sisters who like to stir things up!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: We both love this city and want to do everything together. We want to see what this world has to offer.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And I think that An and I will, together!

rows.Speaker: Shopkeeper
rows.Line: Still, you two are so close. I see you all the time together. You're almost like sisters.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Sisters...? That seems like a stretch considering how much older I am than her.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, don't say that.
Same offer. I'll double what you get if you beat me at rock paper scissors.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I'm not falling for that again.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line:
...
An, it's okay. Just let it all out...

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Have you ever heard the saying about how the tears of mourners help flowers grow in heaven?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: For every mourner, a flower blooms up above for their loved one. In other words, the more mourners, the more flowers.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Nagi was supposed to rest on a great bed of flowers...

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line:
But we chose to respect her wishes.
We chose to deprive her of that...

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line:
So, An...
It's okay for you to cry now.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Don't feel bad about crying. You have every right to, considering just how much you loved her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I...! I wish we could've talked more!

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line:
I know, dear...
I would've loved to see that as well...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
(Let it all out...
For me. For all of us...)
